summary: Backend-only testing of Zayado auth + admin panel flows used by the WordPress 'Zayado Admin' plugin. 11/11 pytest tests passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified: health, admin JWT login, demo login, unauthenticated admin endpoint returns 401/403, /api/admin/stats non-empty, /api/admin/users listing + plan filter, /api/admin/config, POST /api/admin/users/{id}/credits with both {amount} (the main fix) and {credits} (backcompat), and PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/plan.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py is large (1000+ lines) — could be split into stats/users/credits/plans submodules for maintainability.
gift_credits accepts both {amount} and {credits}; consider marking one as deprecated in OpenAPI schema so plugin authors converge on {amount}.

test_admin_users_filter_by_plan_free passed but returned users list may be empty in this env — filter correctness only asserted on returned rows; if a stricter test is desired seed at least one free user.
seed_data_creation: None. Test mutates credits/plan of an existing non-admin seed user (acceptable per request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only auth + admin panel WP-plugin flows were tested per scope. Other routers (Mollie, OAuth, Brevo, activite, agents, etc.) intentionally skipped. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter_admin_plugin.py as regression for the WP plugin contract.
rca of the issue: N/A — the reported fix (accepting {amount} in POST /api/admin/users/{id}/credits) is verified working and backwards-compatible with {credits}.
